verdict.rationale: Twilio ships AI-powered features such as conversation intelligence, transcription and agent memory, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of a setting, policy or contractual control that keeps customer data out of AI model training. The community items cover breaches and messaging compliance, not AI training, so they are irrelevant here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
